items.claim: Mark Brand 在 Project Zero 的最早可核验公开研究为 2015-02 的 Flash PCRE（CVE-2015-0318）漏洞利用，自署 'Irregular Expressionist'。选择 Flash/PCRE 作为起点对应当时 Flash 仍是浏览器主导攻击面、且 PCRE 正则引擎可达的约束；利用路径为无效字节码→指针操控→OOB 写→Vector.<uint> 长度损坏→任意读写→ROP。
items.growth_signal: 机制：目标选择受当时最高暴露攻击面（Flash）驱动；面对 'surprisingly robust' 的 PCRE 字节码校验，他没有放弃而是承认 'took quite a while before I found a useful primitive'，体现重复试错而非天赋叙事；收尾 'Make zeroday hard.' 已在首篇确立为贯穿后续十年的输出习惯。

items.claim: Brand 自署 'Bypasser of Mitigations'，转向 Android Stagefright（CVE-2015-3864）。选择该 bug 的理由是它赋予攻击者对 'the size of the allocation; the amount of overflow, and the contents' 的三重控制；在 mediaserver 难以构造信息泄露的约束下，选择对 8-bit ASLR 直接暴力枚举（1/256）而非追求信息泄露，实测约 ~4%/分钟 成功率。
items.growth_signal: 机制：领域转换（Flash→Android media）跟随远程预认证高暴露面迁移；关键决策是约束下的可选项取舍——放弃昂贵的信息泄露、接受暴力枚举的较低可靠性，因为 watering-hole 场景允许多次重试。这是其后反复出现的 'pragmatism over elegance' 决策模式的首个明确实例。
items.short_quote: a linear heap-overflow giving the attacker control over the size of the allocation; the amount of overflow, and the contents

source.title: Stagefrightened?
source.source_type: Project Zero 博客（独立署名）

items.claim: Brand 选择 SwiftShader 作为攻击面，因 GPU 进程 'needs to have more privileges than the highly-sandboxed renderer processes'，且 Chrome 在 GPU 加速失败 4 次后会回退到 SwiftShader，故该面始终可达；方法论上他明确提出 'look at things sideways — avoiding the perhaps more obvious and highly contested areas such as the main javascript JIT engine'。
items.growth_signal: 机制：目标选择从 '正面强攻 JIT' 转向 '横向寻找非显见子系统'，这是其工具建设与选点习惯的核心启发式——攻击 GPU 回退路径而非主 JS 引擎。通过可主动触发的环境降级（crash GPU 4 次）把 '非默认路径' 转化为 '可强制可达路径'。
items.short_quote: look at things sideways — avoiding the perhaps more obvious and highly contested areas such as the main javascript JIT engine

source.title: Heap Feng Shader: Exploiting SwiftShader in Chrome
source.source_type: Project Zero 博客（独立署名）

items.claim: Brand 自署 'Exploit Technique Archaeologist'，选择 Chrome Mojo IPC 作为全链沙箱逃逸目标。明确决策链：(a) MojoJS binding 使 IPC 可从 JS 直接调用，故可借渲染端漏洞启用 binding 后从 JS 做提权；(b) 先发现 'a collection of possible sandbox escape vulnerabilities'，再选 issue 1755，理由为 'the high level of control the attacker has both over the lifetime of the free'd object, and over the timing of the later use'；(c) ASLR 绕过放弃信息泄露，改用 ~3.5TB 虚拟地址喷射，利用 Windows 无跨进程 ASLR 与浏览器进程无地址空间上限两项设计缺口。
items.growth_signal: 机制：选择沙箱逃逸而非渲染端 bug，因 'sandbox escape is the critical escalation step'——把研究投入放在全链中稀缺环节；选 bug 时以 '攻击者对对象生命周期与重用时机的控制度' 为评估准则，而非 bug 表象。ASLR 决策体现 '创造性消除约束优于正面突破'：用环境结构弱点（无限地址空间）替代信息泄露原语。
items.short_quote: the cleanest way to implement a full Chrome chain would be to use a renderer exploit to enable these bindings in the running renderer

source.title: Virtually Unlimited Memory: Escaping the Chrome Sandbox
source.source_type: Project Zero 博客（独立署名）

items.claim: Brand 与 Glazunov 选择 Chrome 网络栈，因其 'has been split out into a new service process, the implementation of strict sandboxing for that process isn't completed yet, so it's still a highly privileged attack surface'，并称 'this bug alone would be enough to both get initial code execution, and to break out of the Chrome sandbox'。写作目的明确为 'to illustrate the difficulties that even experienced researchers sometimes face'，并坦承 'we'd just been too lazy to set up a build environment' 与 'This was a major face-palm moment'。
items.growth_signal: 机制：目标选择捕捉架构转型窗口——servicification 已分进程但沙箱未完成，使网络进程同时具备远程可达与高特权。输出习惯上选择公开失败与惰性（'too lazy'、'face-palm'）作为一等内容，把研究叙事转化为可复用的失败教训而非成功传记，构成其 'honest research journey' 文体。
items.short_quote: the implementation of strict sandboxing for that process isn't completed yet, so it's still a highly privileged attack surface

source.title: A day^W^W Several months in the life of Project Zero - Part 1
source.source_type: Project Zero 博客（与 Sergei Glazunov 合著）

items.claim: Brand 从进攻演示转向防御评估，发布 MTE Part 1，核心研究问题为 'whether it's possible to use this instruction set extension to implement effective security mitigations, or whether its use is limited to debugging/fault detection purposes'。建立分类法：Soft mitigation='attacker pays a one-time cost'；Hard mitigation='cannot develop a bypass technique which is reusable between different vulnerabilities'；Solution='eliminates exploitability of a vulnerability or class'。设定 95% 可靠性阈值（CONFIG_HZ_250 下需 ~0.2ms 完成）。
items.growth_signal: 机制：方法转型——从 '找 bug/写 exploit' 转向 '以攻击者视角评估防御是否成立'。建立可量化的评估框架（soft/hard/solution + 明确可靠性阈值），使 '缓解措施是否有效' 从主观判断转为可复现度量。这是其智识谱系从纯进攻到攻防一体的关键转折。
items.short_quote: whether it's possible to use this instruction set extension to implement effective security mitigations, or whether its use is limited to debugging/fault detection purposes

items.claim: Brand 发布 Pixel 8 MTE 落地指南，称 'It's finally time for me to fulfill a long-standing promise'，并追溯其自 late 2017 起关注 MTE。自述 'I've been running my Pixel 8 with MTE enabled since release day, and so far I haven't found any issues'，在 stock image 上用 ADB setprop 三步将 MTE 默认从 opt-in 改为 opt-out。定位为 'MTE is not a silver bullet for memory safety' 但 'huge step forward'。
items.growth_signal: 机制：把评估结论转为可操作交付物（ADB 步骤+opt-out 配置），并以自用真机作为可信度背书。'兑现承诺' 的叙事显示其研究以长期承诺为驱动，而非短期产出；对 'silver bullet' 的拒绝与对 'huge step forward' 的肯定并存，体现渐进式防御投资观。

items.claim: Brand 与 Glazunov 发布 Project Naptime，明确方法转型：'we're always looking for new approaches'，目标为 'automated detection of unfuzzable vulnerabilities'，自 mid 2023 起与 DeepMind 合作出 LLM 辅助研究框架。提出五原则：Space for Reasoning、Interactive Environment、Specialised Tools、Perfect Verification、Sampling Strategy，主张 LLM 应复现人类研究员的系统性方法而非单次提示。
items.growth_signal: 机制：方法转型的第二条线——把人类研究员方法论编码给 LLM。五原则直接来自其过往研究习惯（verbose 推理、交互式纠错、专用工具、可确定性验证、多假设独立采样），是把 tacit practice 显式化为可复制框架的产物；选 'unfuzzable' 为切入点，是把 LLM 用在传统工具盲区而非与 fuzzer 竞争。
